{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Clean: keep only the highest sample_seq per patient
df_clean = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the distribution of severity and arm to confirm we have both groups
print("Distribution of severity by arm:")
df_clean.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)"}
